title: Hittite remains in underground cities show they were reused

tellings.quote: they found uh evidence of Hittites and evidence of um ancient cultures that are not like Ancient Ancient

plain: The underground cities at Derinkuyu in Turkey, a network of rooms and tunnels carved deep into the rock, show traces of the Hittites, an ancient people of the region, and of other early cultures that came later than the people who first dug them. That is how the researcher Matt LaCroix puts it, without naming a source. He tells it to suggest that later peoples moved into these tunnels and reused them, so the cities would be older than those who left their remains there.
